title: Shipping stationery to Japan
ask: Yuki Tanaka in Osaka wants to know whether Paper Wren ships notebooks to Japan and what it costs. Her email is in inbox/customer.txt and our rates are in shipping/rates.md. Write the reply and send it.
background: She is asking about three A5 notebooks, which weigh about 900 grams packed.
We post overseas parcels on Tuesdays and Fridays.
The rates sheet was updated last week and is the only source to use.

constraints.text: quote the postage in dollars, and no figure above $28
use a bulleted list of exactly three points
no contractions, since she may be reading in a second language
don't look anything up on the web, shipping/rates.md is enough
say plainly that "customs fees are not included"
give the delivery estimate as "10 to 14 business days"

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: yuki.tanaka@customer.example
Subject: Shipping to Japan?

Hello, do you ship to Osaka? I would like three A5 notebooks.

Yuki Tanaka
start.shipping/rates.md:
Japan, up to 1kg: $26 tracked, 10 to 14 business days
Japan, up to 2kg: $38 tracked
